create_dyn_dep_munger: create a dynamic dependency munger for Linux, macOS, or Windows using buildopts and install_dirs
process_deps_DepBase: process and rewrite dynamic library dependencies in installed binaries under a destination directory
find_all_dependencies_DepBase: find all dynamic library dependencies of binaries in a build directory recursively
compute_dependency_paths_WinDeps: compute all PATH directories needed for Windows library dependencies by scanning binaries
emit_dev_run_script_WinDeps: emit a PowerShell dev run script that sets PATH for Windows dependency resolution
